identitySignals: Federal SAM.gov data (via OpenGovUS) lists KILOWATT ENGINEERING, INC. (trade name Kw Engineering) at 287 17th Street, Suite 300, Oakland, CA, an engineering services firm, matching the agenda name and Oakland location
kW Engineering's own contact page gives the same Oakland address (287 17th Street, Suite 300) for kW Engineering, Inc.

OUSD's Board record for the Claremont Middle School New Multi-Purpose Building Project names 'KW Engineering, Oakland, California' for engineering and commissioning design work, which matches kW Engineering's commissioning services
Agenda titles use both 'Kilowatt Engineering, Inc.' and 'KW Engineering, Inc.', consistent with the SAM trade name
research.notes: SAM registration shown as expired on OpenGovUS; UEI is from that record. No general email on the contact page (contact form only). California entity number not verified.

profile.summary: kW Engineering is an energy consulting and engineering firm founded in 1998 in Oakland, California. It provides energy efficiency and sustainable building services, including commissioning, electrification, resiliency solutions and utility program support. It has offices in California, Idaho, Utah and New York.

sources.title: Kw Engineering / Kilowatt Engineering, Inc. - SAM entity

review.notes: SAM.gov record (legal name Kilowatt Engineering, Inc., DBA KW Engineering) and the company contact page share the Oakland address, and OUSD's Board record names KW Engineering of Oakland for commissioning engineering, which fits the school-facilities contracts. Phone, address, website, UEI, founding year, services and office states are all confirmed by the cited pages, and the summary is neutral.
